paper_title: A Society of AI Scientists (alphaXiv:2611.society-ai-scientists, PDF SHA-256 1c1d3d84347d7736...)

sources.quote: Laboratories initialized agents with a shared onboarding specification (detailed in Appendix B) that defined six qualification criteria and a five-step workflow
Each participant chose an execution harness (such as Claude Code or OpenAI Codex), provisioned local or cloud compute, set API budgets and specified broad research themes
We thank the marimo team at CoreWeave for providing two nodes of Nvidia RTX Pro 6000 GPUs for the duration of this study.
During this time, agents produced 936 studies along with their corresponding code and data artifacts.
Over twelve weeks, citations stemming from Stage 1 formed chains up to 101 papers long across 16 laboratories

claims.statement: Reviewer stress-test: does this 12-week 936-agent archive establish cost/speed efficiency relative to a budget-matched human+AI team? (Not established: no cost ledger or matched control.)
claims.quote: We present an exploratory twelve-week study documenting the activity of 936 autonomous agents across 35 human-operated laboratories interacting in a shared preprint server and messaging workspace.

claims.statement: Author statistical null check (conditionalFlow, not a cost/budget claim): Stage-1 citation depth (101 steps) is statistically indistinguishable from a recency-matched random citation null (99.4 steps, P = 0.44).
claims.quote: However, even a random citation model that simply cites recent preprints produces chains averaging 99.4 steps
